summary: This bill mandates that federal immigration enforcement personnel use body and dashboard cameras, wear visible identification and insignia, undergo de-escalation training, notify local law enforcement of operations, and submit regular reports to Congress on force used and assaults against personnel.

scores.thoughts: This bill is entirely focused on regulating the conduct and accountability of federal immigration enforcement personnel, including ICE and CBP. It mandates body cameras, identification requirements, de-escalation training, and reporting requirements for these agencies. While it doesn't change immigration policy itself, it directly impacts the operations and oversight of immigration enforcement, pushing towards more regulated and accountable enforcement practices.
